name: VBScript Payload Stored in Registry
description: Detects VBScript content stored into registry keys as seen being used by UNC2452 group
author: GAI_CTI
query: (registry.path:*Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion* AND (winlog.event_data.Details:(*vbscript\:* OR *jscript\:* OR *mshtml,* OR *RunHTMLApplication* OR *Execute\(* OR *CreateObject* OR *window.close*))) AND (NOT (registry.path:*Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Run* OR (process.executable:*\\msiexec.exe AND registry.path:*\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Installer\\UserData\\* AND (winlog.event_data.Details:(*\\Microsoft.NET\\Primary\ Interop\ Assemblies\\Microsoft.mshtml.dll* OR *\<\\Microsoft.mshtml,fileVersion\=* OR *_mshtml_dll_* OR *\<\\Microsoft.mshtml,culture\=*)))))
